invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieData<WriteStatus> object 'result' which is expected to be non-null at method exit.
Assuming inputs are non-null, the result should also be non-null.
The result relates to the input writeStatuses and likely preserves emptiness.
Since input and output are HoodieData objects, they should not be null at the method exit.
The size of the result collection cannot be negative.
